name: grab-context
description: Firefox extension that copies any clicked element as Markdown for AI coding assistants. Bundles react-grab (MIT, Aiden Bai) for component detection.

scripts.sign:listed: pnpm build && pnpm source-zip && web-ext sign --source-dir=dist --channel=listed --artifacts-dir=web-ext-artifacts --upload-source-code=grab-context-source.zip --api-key="$AMO_JWT_ISSUER" --api-secret="$AMO_JWT_SECRET"
